notes.title: 6.11.2025 Patch Notes
notes.content: Some of the issues experienced with VR devices connected via wireless have been resolved. Improvements have been made to game textures, along with enhancements and optimizations in graphics. Issues causing stuttering in weapon sounds have been fixed. FPS drops caused by certain in-game effects have been reduced. Decals are now more visible.

notes.title: 3.20.25 HotFix 2
notes.content: Some Buggs fixed and light errors fixed.

notes.title: 3.20.25 Patch Notes
notes.content: Some bugs that negatively affected the flow of the game have been fixed. The game's shader settings and material quality have been optimized. Changes have been made to some maps. New weapons have been added.

notes.title: 3.13.2025 Huge Performance Update
notes.content:
Game engine updated
The lag experienced in the wireless internet connection has been resolved.
Modifications were made to the game files, reducing the file size. The files that will be included in the next patch have been removed from within the game.
Improvements and optimizations have been made to the weapon codes and skins.

notes.title: 3.12.2025 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Grap to enemy logic added
 Some gun materials chanced
Some bugs fixed

notes.title: 3.10.2025 Update Notes
notes.content:
The engine files have been updated. Significant improvements and quality enhancements have been made to the visuals. Optimizations have been made to the weapons. 

Fixes have been made to errors that negatively impacted the game flow.

notes.title: 3.1.2025 Patch Notes (Huge Optimization boost)
notes.content:
Some blueprint codes have been rewritten in C++
The lighting system has been optimized to improve performance.
The responses of the NPC's have been slowed down.
Optimization has been applied to the materials.
Some optimization has been applied specifically to the VR Headsets.

notes.title: 18.02.2025 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Performance improvements
Graphical improvements
Small User interfaces chances
Some bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Hotfix 13.02.2025
notes.content:
Some VR Headsets resolution problem solved.
Add 0.5 delay to next teleport.

notes.title: 13.02.2025 Big Update
notes.content:
Three new maps have been added for Escape Mode
Weapon size updates have been made
Improvements were made in graphic optimization.
Teleport efficiency has been increased.
A feature to disable screen sharing has been introduced.

Known issues: Upon first entering the game, the pixel density is increased too much due to a problem, causing tearing and stuttering in the game. The issue will be fixed as soon as possible.

notes.title: 4.02.2025 Big Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch Notes.

Performance improvements have been made.
Some issues with problematic VR headsets have been fixed.
Teleportation has been added, so now there are three types of movement: two walking styles and teleportation.
A new weapon and a new game mode map have been added. Additional continuation maps will be added soon, and bug tests are being carried out.
The weapon pickup radius has been increased to make it easier to reach weapons.
AI difficulty has been reduced in the initial maps; they now fire later. A large portion of the zombies now stop briefly after taking damage.

notes.title: 19.01.2025 Small Update
notes.content:
Numbers have been added to the back of the magazines so you can see how many bullets are left.
The left turn issue has been resolved. The lods of the poorly rendered areas have been updated.
A small optimization has been made to increase the FPS.

notes.title: 15 01 2025 update notes
notes.content:
The AI birthplace algorithm has been changed, Now, a random AI can spawn in some randomly hidden locations. Although the number is low, it helps to overcome some of the memorization.

A small optimization was made regarding issues with the connections of some VR Headsets. While it doesn't completely resolve the problem, it provides a slight improvemen

Some collision bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Performance optimization, New zombie map, Visual update
notes.content:
The game's textures have been optimized for VR headsets experiencing issues. The AI clothing packs have been updated. The AI's turns are now a bit smoother. A new zombie map has been added



Work is being done to fix the zombie sound issue.
